Name: Opulence
Author: twinkle22
Description:
Hello This is a collection of opulent AT furniture.  All these assets are by the very talented Aqua, and I was given special permission to use them for my mod.  You can find them here: [url=https://byaqua.itch.io/opulence]https://byaqua.itch.io/opulence[/url]  I have included some guides in the pictures, so you know what the items change into. You will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]alternative textures[/url]﻿ to use this mod. I also recommend having [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB item spawner[/url]﻿ to get all the furniture items fast, but if you prefer you can purchase the items from Robins catalogue.Unfortunately the lights and windows do not change, I'm thinking of making a version where they do. I will also hopefully be releasing a matching kitchen mod soon. :)

For personal use only; further modification and/or redistribution of the graphics within this mod is not allowed under any circumstance.
